name: Dalton Burger
description: The park's most popular burger restaurant located in the heart of the Western-themed area near Dalton Terror, serving generous Belgian-style burgers, chicken sandwiches, fries and soft drinks. Dalton Burger is a Walibi Belgium institution — the go-to lunch stop for families wanting a hearty, satisfying meal between rides. The Western saloon atmosphere and outdoor terrace make it one of the most atmospheric dining spots in the park.

items.description: Beef burger with lettuce, tomato and fries

items.name: Chicken Burger
items.description: Crispy chicken fillet burger with fries

items.name: Kids Meal
items.description: Small burger or nuggets with fries and drink

name: Delhicious
description: One of the most unique and popular dining options at Walibi Belgium — Delhicious brings authentic Indian street food flavours to the park with fragrant curries, naan breads, samosas and spiced rice dishes that stand out from the typical theme park burger-and-fries fare. A refreshing and flavourful alternative that draws long queues on busy days, particularly popular with adult visitors seeking something different.

items.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
items.description: Classic Indian curry with basmati rice and naan

items.name: Vegetable Samosas
items.description: Crispy pastry parcels filled with spiced vegetables

items.name: Naan Bread
items.description: Freshly baked naan with dipping sauce

name: N'Soso
description: An exciting and distinctive African street food concept that brings the vibrant flavours of West African cuisine to Walibi Belgium — grilled meats, plantain, jollof rice and flavourful stews served in a colourfully themed setting. N'Soso is one of the most culturally interesting dining stops in any Belgian theme park and reflects Walibi's commitment to diverse dining options that go well beyond the usual theme park menu.

items.name: Grilled Chicken
items.description: Marinated grilled chicken with jollof rice and plantain

items.name: Stew Bowl
items.description: Rich flavourful African stew with rice

items.name: Plantain
items.description: Fried sweet plantain with dipping sauce

name: Pizza Solo
description: A straightforward and reliable pizza restaurant offering freshly baked individual and sharing pizzas with a range of classic toppings — the perfect solution for families with varying tastes who want a universally popular meal without queuing at multiple food stands. Pizza Solo is centrally located and offers a decent-sized indoor and outdoor seating area making it one of the easier places to find a table on busy days.
